relationships.subject: chelidonic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Chelidonic acid treatment also resulted in a considerable rise in Nrf2 levels (p < 0.001)

relationships.subject: chelidonic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Conversely, HIF-1α expression was significantly declined in the chelidonic acid treatment.

relationships.subject: chelidonic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Inflammatory markers such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1β concentrations, as well as nitric oxide and C-reactive protein, were significantly decreased in the chelidonic acid-treated group.

relationships.subject: chelidonic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that chelidonic acid significantly normalized mechanical allodynia, hyperalgesia, and thermal hyperalgesia.

key_findings: Chelidonic acid normalized pain behaviours and nerve conduction in paclitaxel-treated rats.
It raised Nrf2 and pAMPK and lowered HIF-1alpha and inflammatory cytokines in the sciatic nerve.
